rawInput.answer: Application-level route handling is wired up in lib/application.js: app.init() lazily creates `this.router` (getter), app.use()/app.route() delegate to it, and lib/express.js re-exports Router. However, the router itself is NOT implemented in this repo — both files do `var Router = require('router')`, and package.json lists `"router": "^2.2.0"` as an external npm dependency (the separate expressjs/router package).
